FRC 是面向高中阶段学生的国际机器人竞赛。每年赛季开始，队伍面对新的比赛任务，: FRC is an international robotics competition for high school students. Each season brings a new challenge. Teams design, build and program their own robots, then take them onto the field.
比赛中，队伍组成联盟共同完成挑战。技术、临场策略和团队协作，都会影响一场比赛的表: Teams form alliances to tackle the challenge together. Engineering, match strategy and teamwork all shape how an alliance performs.

机器人背后，是彼此依靠的一群人。: Behind every robot is a team whose members depend on one another.
